description: MainActivity.kt defines the main activity for an Android application, managing UI components such as calculator keypad, voice search, result display, and history drawer. It handles user interactions, speech results, expression evaluation, and history management.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing calculator operations, voice input, history panel, theme toggling, and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, UI components, event handlers, and history panel.

methods.name: updateResultBox
methods.description: Updates the result display with a new expression.

methods.name: setupUndoRedoButtons
methods.description: Configures the undo and redo button click handlers.

methods.name: updateUndoRedoButtonStates
methods.description: Enables/disables undo/redo buttons based on current history state.

methods.name: evaluateAndShowResult
methods.description: Evaluates the current expression and shows the result; updates history.

methods.name: wireCalculatorKeypad
methods.description: Sets up the calculator keypad buttons to append symbols or evaluate expressions.

methods.name: setupHistoryPanel
methods.description: Initializes the history drawer button and overlay click handling.

methods.name: showHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Inflates and displays the history drawer with animation.

methods.name: hideHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Closes the history drawer with animation.

methods.name: populateHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Populates the history drawer RecyclerView with calculation history.

methods.name: updateHistoryPanelIfVisible
methods.description: Refreshes the history drawer if currently visible.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for theme toggling.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Switches between light and dark themes.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles permission results for voice input.
